⚠️ Gaps & assumptions

Places where the result differs from the mocks, or where I made a call.

  • Card width above 1370px: the 1700px mock shows a 1212px card. The page layout caps it at 760px. Changing that means editing the layout next to the sidebar, so I left it alone.
  • Sidebar breakpoint: the 1270px mock shows the sidebar, but the app only switches to it at 1370px. Left as is.
  • Product names: the mocks used different names at different sizes. I used the 1270px desktop names everywhere. Mobile descriptions are placeholders, as in the mock.
  • Overlapping widths: 767px and 933px each appear in two mocks. I chose ≤767 = stacked, 768–933 = flipped table, ≥934 = table.
  • Fee values don't carry across layouts: the inputs are display-only, so a typed value won't carry over if the window crosses 768px. Checkbox state does carry over.
